title: 半曲长安
reviewStatus: Source-informed multi-ASR audit; human listening confirmation pending
timingStatus: ASR word anchors, approximate; not forced-aligned or approved for recording
notes: The 28 entries map one-to-one to the full-mix large-v3 no-VAD segments, not the incomplete VAD transcript.
MOSS-Music and both no-VAD passes recover the second chorus and the complete two-line ending.
Retain source-close homophones: 别, 渐淡, 半首, 一半, 兰州, 丹霞, 远山, 可一想, 漫天, 未尽, 弹完.
城南 is retained from the input and MOSS; Whisper repeatedly hears 城门. This is the main unresolved listening check.
Discard unsupported composer credits hallucinated only in the separated-stem no-VAD intro.
Instrumental gaps are not lyric lines. The first ASR's duplicated endings for seed 91301 are not applicable to this seed.

lines.en: Wind from the city walls brushes my sleeves.
lines.ja: 城壁を渡る風が袖をなでる

lines.en: You pin the evening glow upon my shoulder.
lines.ja: あなたは夕焼けを私の肩に留めた

lines.en: Our melody unfinished, the sky grows dark.
lines.ja: 一曲を弾き終えぬまま日は暮れて

lines.en: Wait for me, I said; we will play the next part.
lines.ja: 待っていてと告げた、続きは帰ってから

lines.en: Hoofbeats recede; the lanterns slowly fade.
lines.ja: ひづめの音は遠ざかり灯りは薄れる

lines.en: I turn: you are still there, south of the city.
lines.ja: 振り返れば街の南にまだあなたがいる

lines.en: Half our melody stays in Chang'an.
lines.ja: 琴の調べの半分は長安に残して

lines.en: Half travels with me over a thousand mountains.
lines.ja: もう半分は私と千の山を越える

lines.en: No breadth of the Yellow River can divide this longing.
lines.ja: 黄河がどれほど広くても想いは隔てられない

lines.en: Through all the wind and sand, I would know your eyes.
lines.ja: どんな砂嵐の中でもあなたの瞳を見つける

lines.en: When I return, I will sit beside you.
lines.ja: 帰ったらあなたのそばに座って

lines.en: And softly play our unfinished melody to its end.
lines.ja: 残りの調べをそっと弾き終えよう

lines.en: Night in Lanzhou; starlight rests upon the water.
lines.ja: 蘭州の夜、水面に星が映る

lines.en: The danxia cliffs burn red across the distant hills.
lines.ja: 炎のような丹霞が遠い山々を赤く染める

lines.en: My red robes stir as I round the mountain bend.
lines.ja: 紅い衣を風になびかせ山の曲がり道を越える

lines.en: May everyone behind me find their way home safely.
lines.ja: 後ろに続く人たちがみな無事でありますように

lines.en: I too have feared the long road home.
lines.ja: 帰り道の長さが怖くなる日もあった

lines.en: I too have hidden tears inside the moonlight.
lines.ja: 月明かりに涙を隠す夜もあった

lines.en: But when I think of you still waiting by the window,
lines.ja: けれど窓辺で待つあなたを想えば

lines.en: Every wind beneath the sky blows home to Chang'an.
lines.ja: 空いっぱいの風がみな長安へと吹いていく

lines.en: Half our melody stays in Chang'an.
lines.ja: 琴の調べの半分は長安に残して

lines.en: Half travels with me over a thousand mountains.
lines.ja: もう半分は私と千の山を越える

lines.en: No breadth of the Yellow River can divide this longing.
lines.ja: 黄河がどれほど広くても想いは隔てられない

lines.en: Through all the wind and sand, I would know your eyes.
lines.ja: どんな砂嵐の中でもあなたの瞳を見つける

lines.en: When I return, I will sit beside you.
lines.ja: 帰ったらあなたのそばに座って

lines.en: And softly play our unfinished melody to its end.
lines.ja: 残りの調べをそっと弾き終えよう

lines.en: That melody we left unfinished,
lines.ja: あの日弾き終えなかった調べを

lines.en: Tonight, I finish it for you.
lines.ja: 今夜あなたのために最後まで奏でる
